query:
WITH titles AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT library_id, item_id, kind, path, season, episode, own_id, listed_id,
                      ROW_NUMBER() OVER title AS nth, MIN(item_id) OVER title AS title_item,
                      MIN(added_at) OVER title AS first_added_at,
                      MAX(added_at) OVER title AS newest_added_at,
                      IIF(kind = 'movie', MIN(added_at) OVER title, MAX(added_at) OVER title)
                          AS added_at
               FROM (SELECT library_files.library_id, library_items.id AS item_id, library_items.kind,
                      library_files.path, library_items.season, library_items.episode,
                      library_items.added_at, (SELECT substr(MIN(printf('%05d', coalesce(nullif(instr(
                         ',' || libraries.title_sources || ',', ',' || candidate.namespace || ','),
                         0), 99999)) || candidate.namespace || '-' || candidate.value), 6)
              FROM item_match_ids AS candidate
              WHERE candidate.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND candidate.scope = 'title') AS own_id, (SELECT substr(MIN(printf('%05d', coalesce(nullif(instr(
                         ',' || libraries.title_sources || ',', ',' || candidate.namespace || ','),
                         0), 99999)) || candidate.namespace || '-' || candidate.value), 6)
              FROM item_match_ids AS candidate
              WHERE candidate.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND candidate.scope = IIF(library_items.kind = 'movie', 'title', 'show')) AS listed_id
               FROM item_matches
               JOIN library_items ON library_items.id = item_matches.item_id
               JOIN library_files ON library_files.id = library_items.file_id
               JOIN libraries ON libraries.id = library_files.library_id
               WHERE item_matches.state = 'matched'
                 AND library_items.kind = IIF(libraries.kind = 'movies', 'movie', 'episode')
                 AND own_id IS NOT NULL AND listed_id IS NOT NULL
                 AND (library_items.kind = 'movie'
                      OR (library_items.season IS NOT NULL
                          AND library_items.episode IS NOT NULL)))
               WINDOW title AS (PARTITION BY library_id, listed_id
                                ORDER BY season, episode, path
                                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)) AS library_titles
                                 WHERE library_id = ?1 AND kind = 'episode')
                       SELECT titles.listed_id AS "listed_id!: String",
                              titles.own_id AS "own_id!: String",
                              library_files.id AS "file!", library_files.path,
                              library_files.size, library_files.modified_ns,
                              library_files.parser_version, titles.season AS "season!: i64",
                              titles.episode AS "episode!: i64",
                              item_matches.plugin AS "plugin!", (SELECT json_group_object(namespace, value) FROM item_match_ids
              WHERE item_match_ids.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND scope = 'title') AS "ids?: String", (SELECT json_group_object(namespace, value) FROM item_match_ids
              WHERE item_match_ids.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND scope = 'show') AS "show_ids?: String",
                              item_matches.title AS "title!",
                              item_matches.show_title AS "show_title!",
                              overview, release_date, runtime_minutes, poster, poster_plugin,
                              backdrop, backdrop_plugin, titled_backdrop, titled_backdrop_plugin,
                              logo, logo_plugin, still, genres,
                              content_rating, show_poster, show_poster_plugin, show_overview,
                              show_first_air_date, metadata_version, item_matches.original_language,
                              title_details.score AS "score?",
                              title_details.trailers AS "trailers?",
                              titles.added_at AS "added_at!: i64"
                       FROM titles
                       JOIN item_matches ON item_matches.item_id = titles.item_id
                       JOIN library_items ON library_items.id = titles.item_id
                       JOIN library_files ON library_files.id = library_items.file_id
                       -- Keyed as `details::store` keys it.
                       LEFT JOIN title_details
                           ON title_details.plugin = item_matches.plugin
                          AND title_details.kind = 'show'
                          AND (title_details.namespace, title_details.value) =
                              (SELECT keyed.namespace, keyed.value FROM item_match_ids AS keyed
                               WHERE keyed.item_id = item_matches.item_id
                                 AND keyed.scope = 'show'
                               ORDER BY keyed.namespace LIMIT 1)
                       WHERE ?2 IS NULL
                          OR titles.listed_id IN (
                              SELECT asked.listed_id FROM titles AS asked
                              JOIN item_match_ids AS named
                                ON named.item_id = asked.item_id AND named.scope = 'show'
                              JOIN json_each(?2) AS only
                                ON only.value = named.namespace || '-' || named.value)
                       ORDER BY titles.listed_id, titles.nth
